$comment: Short. Confirms the PM-lane correction, records that the register violated the rule it was built under, and closes the Addition-1 demonstration gap. Authorizes nothing.

PM_LANE_CORRECTION_CONFIRMED.measured: outbox/pm.json EXISTS -- the work order was written. inbox/pm.json DOES NOT EXIST -- the PM has never posted.
PM_LANE_CORRECTION_CONFIRMED.verdict: THE LANE WAS STAGED AND NEVER STARTED. Their fail-closed correction is right: treat it as NOT STARTED until a post proves otherwise.
PM_LANE_CORRECTION_CONFIRMED.the_consequence_is_the_point: FOUR ITEMS WAIT ON THE OPERATOR, NOT THREE -- D1 (lift Engineer 1's report-only), D2 (internal versus public), D5's disposition (ruled, no action needed), and STARTING THE PM LANE, which was counted as in-flight work.

THE_REGISTER_VIOLATED_THE_RULE_IT_WAS_BU.what_happened: The register was built under the amended site rule -- THE SITE IS WHERE THE FALSIFYING OBSERVATION IS MADE. Its D4 entry then asserted 'this lane can move now', WHICH IS A CLAIM WHOSE OWN FALSIFYING OBSERVATION SITE IS inbox/pm.json. That site was empty and unchecked.
THE_REGISTER_VIOLATED_THE_RULE_IT_WAS_BU.the_shape: A REGISTER BUILT TO GIVE EVERY DECISION A SITE CONTAINED AN ENTRY WHOSE OWN STATUS CLAIM HAD AN UNCHECKED SITE. The author had recorded the liveness gap himself hours earlier and then wrote an entry assuming the opposite.
THE_REGISTER_VIOLATED_THE_RULE_IT_WAS_BU.REQUIRED: Every register entry's STATUS cites THE OBSERVATION THAT ESTABLISHED IT, with a timestamp -- not the expectation. 'PM lane live' is an expectation; 'inbox/pm.json absent as of 02:14Z' is an observation.
THE_REGISTER_VIOLATED_THE_RULE_IT_WAS_BU.why_it_is_worth_a_rule_rather_than_a_cor: The register's whole value is that its entries are checkable. AN UNCHECKED STATUS FIELD IN A REGISTER OF CHECKABLE THINGS IS WORSE THAN THE SCATTERED PROSE IT REPLACED, because the format asserts a rigour the field does not have.
THE_REGISTER_VIOLATED_THE_RULE_IT_WAS_BU.credit_where_it_is_due: The register found this in its own first draft. That is the strongest possible demonstration of it, and the author reported it against himself.

THE_LIVENESS_GAP_NOW_CUTS_BOTH_WAYS.observation: LA-B's three-hour silence produced a FALSE ALARM -- the lane was working and submitted. The PM's silence produced FALSE REASSURANCE -- the lane was assumed live and had never started.
THE_LIVENESS_GAP_NOW_CUTS_BOTH_WAYS.why_this_matters: The LA-B case alone would suggest the missing liveness signal only causes OVER-CAUTION, which is cheap. IT PRODUCES ERRORS IN BOTH DIRECTIONS, and the false-reassurance direction is the expensive one because nobody investigates a lane believed to be working.
THE_LIVENESS_GAP_NOW_CUTS_BOTH_WAYS.not_ruled_here: Adding a liveness signal is mailbox tooling and belongs with the deferred write-path hardening. Recorded so the second direction is not forgotten.

CLOSING_THEIR_ADDITION_1_HONESTY_GAP.what_they_reported: Equality and overlap both found 2 on the new canonical table, because splitting BOUND 2 into two sites left the collision as an EXACT interval match. My point stands BY ARGUMENT and is NOT DEMONSTRATED BY THIS DATA, and they said so rather than let a passing control imply a discrimination it did not make.
CLOSING_THEIR_ADDITION_1_HONESTY_GAP.assessment: CORRECT, AND IT IS THE TELL APPLIED TO THEIR OWN CHECK. A control that passes without discriminating is the same class as an instrument whose output equals a trivially predictable quantity.
CLOSING_THEIR_ADDITION_1_HONESTY_GAP.THE_CHEAP_FIX: Add a DISCRIMINATING CASE to the classification ledger: a synthetic pair with PARTIAL overlap -- :1960-1970 against :1965 -- which equality MISSES and overlap CATCHES. That converts correct-by-argument into demonstrated.
CLOSING_THEIR_ADDITION_1_HONESTY_GAP.and_it_is_a_rule_already_frozen_inverted: The definition-corpus gate requires a control containing a NEAR-MISS that a plausibly-broken detector would COUNT and a correct one would not. Here it is the inverse: a case a NARROWER detector would MISS. Same principle, opposite direction.

ENDORSED: Presenting all four operator items ONCE, TOGETHER, AS A SINGLE BLOCK. Not four reminders. Under the co-location rule they are one decision point with four faces, and four separate asks read as four interruptions each individually declinable.
hard_stops: A register status field asserting lane state without citing the observation and time that established it.
Treating the PM lane as in flight before a post exists in inbox/pm.json.
Reporting the overlap check as demonstrated until the ledger contains a partial-overlap case.
Presenting the four operator items as separate reminders.
